notes:
Fix 2026-10-17 by claude (f8af9fb5b): Destroyed vessel behind the IVessel interface: Player.Vessel and GameDataSO.LocalPlayer now hand out a real null once destroyed and VesselController.Transform is guarded (578702968); DomainVolumeIndicator holds its last cell mid-swap (ab6e5e9f8). In bleeding-edge since 2026-10-15. Pull bleeding-edge.

Fix 2026-11-20 by claude (5787029688): Checked again 2026-11-20: the stack reads VesselController.cs:226 get_Transform, which is the getter BEFORE 5787029688 made it answer null on a destroyed hull (in today's file line 226 is a comment). ToyNavigationBeacon reads it through _player?.Vessel?.Transform and stops on null. Silent since 2026-10-18.
